input.goal: Synthetic contract fixture: design a passive workshop jig for staged one-handed assembly of the supplied low-force interlocking instrument-enclosure mockup. The supplied base, four walls and lid keep their measured geometry and joint family. Transfer persistent panel holding/alignment duties to exterior braces while preserving every measured joint-access window. Start with the front gate parked, load fresh base, engage the gate when appropriate, locate/join all walls and lid, release and park the gate only after declared completed-joint retention, extract forward, place finished and reset. No physical insertion-force, retention or stability success has been observed.

facts.allowedBodySupports: None. Only the declared table, jig baseplate, outside braces and removable gate may support workpieces.
facts.notes: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE. Six loose user-supplied pre-cut panels form a low-force interlocking instrument enclosure. Panel dimensions and joint access windows must be confirmed from an actual part set. Completed-joint self-retention is an illustrative declared assumption, not an observed pass. No cutting, drilling, adhesive curing, high-force pressing or powered work is supported. The supplied workpiece is not generated by this jig compiler.

output.title: One-handed passive jig for low-force instrument enclosure mockup
output.summary: Passive jig for 160x110x75 enclosure: 260x190 baseplate, 6 split exterior braces, removable front gate with top relief, one-handed staged sequence load base, engage gate, locate/join 4 walls then lid, release/park gate, extract forward, place finished, reset. Preserves all joint windows; retention and force untested.
output.rationale: Checker reports no hard errors: split left/right/rear exterior braces avoid confirmed joint windows (left 30-65, right 35-65, rear 65-95), front gate relief covers front 40-80 with remaining web at/below window bottom, all support duties map to matching edges, gate starts parked, engages after base locate, releases/parks only after all walls and lid joins, forward extraction corridor and finished area fit table/reach. Physical insertion force, self-retention, stability and one-handed operation remain untested trial requirements.
assumptions: Declared completedJointsSelfRetain=true is an illustrative assumption, not an observed pass; gate removal, parking, forward extraction and finished placement require physical trial.
All joints are low-force hand-insertable interlocking panels; insertion force, friction, bowing, springback and stability are untested.
Exterior braces and removable front gate provide only passive alignment/holding; they do not establish one-handed operability, force resistance or tolerance compliance.

Supply points are planar points outside jig, parked gate, extraction corridor and finished footprint; full stock footprints, transfer paths, insertion sweeps and vertical reach require physical verification.
No cutting, drilling, gluing, high-force pressing, powered work, second hand or body support is available.
